overview: This document outlines the System Specification for a comprehensive Travel Booking Platform. The platform enables users to search, compare, and book flights and hotels. It utilizes a microservices architecture deployed on a cloud-based infrastructure for scalability and resilience. The system will integrate with various external providers for real-time flight/hotel availability and payment processing.
architecture: The system adopts a client-server architecture based on microservices. This approach allows for independent development, deployment, and scaling of individual services. The frontend is built using React to provide a responsive user experience. The backend consists of independently deployable microservices handling User Authentication (CAP-01), Flight Search (CAP-02), and Hotel Search (CAP-03). A relational database stores persistent data, while Redis caching improves performance for frequently accessed data. Communication between services occurs primarily through RESTful APIs with potential use of message queues for asynchronous operations. The infrastructure is cloud-based to ensure horizontal scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes will be utilized for managing deployments.

constraints.description: Security Compliance: System must comply with PCI DSS standards for handling sensitive payment information.
constraints.rationale: Ensures secure transaction processing and builds user trust.

constraints.description: Scalability: The system must handle a peak load of 10,000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
constraints.rationale: Accommodates growing user base and seasonal travel demand.

constraints.description: Real-time Data: Flight and hotel availability data must be near real-time (latency < 2 seconds).
constraints.rationale: Provides accurate information to users, preventing booking conflicts.

constraints.description: Integration Complexity: Integration with third-party APIs requires robust error handling and fault tolerance.
constraints.rationale: Ensures system stability even if external services are unavailable or experience issues.

components.name: User Interface (React)
components.description: The React-based frontend provides a responsive and intuitive user experience for searching and booking flights and hotels. It communicates with the backend microservices through REST APIs.

components.name: User Authentication Service (CAP-01)
components.description: Manages user registration, login, password reset, and session management. Uses industry-standard authentication protocols like OAuth 2.0.

components.name: Flight Search Service (CAP-02)
components.description: Handles flight search requests, interacting with external APIs to retrieve real-time flight availability and pricing. Implements auto-suggestions and date validation.
responsibilities: Communicating with airline APIs (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre)

components.name: Hotel Search Service (CAP-03)
components.description: Handles hotel search requests, integrating with external APIs to retrieve real-time hotel availability, pricing, and amenities.
responsibilities: Communicating with hotel APIs (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com)

components.name: Payment Gateway Integration
components.description: Integrates with payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) to process secure online payments.
responsibilities: Processing credit card and other payment methods

components.name: Database (Relational)
components.description: Stores persistent data such as user profiles, booking details, and flight/hotel information.

components.name: Redis Cache
components.description: Provides fast access to frequently accessed data, reducing database load and improving performance.

elements.name: Traveler
elements.description: A user who searches and books flights/hotels.

elements.name: Travel Booking Platform
elements.description: The core system for searching, comparing, and booking travel arrangements.

elements.name: Airline API (Amadeus/Sabre)
elements.description: Provides real-time flight availability and pricing data.

elements.name: Hotel API (Expedia/Booking.com)
elements.description: Provides real-time hotel availability, pricing, and amenities.
